caveats: No Clawson zoning ordinance or Clawson zoning map was found. emery.utah.gov lists zoning maps for Castle Dale, Cleveland, Elmo, Emery, Ferron, Green River, Huntington and Orangeville, not Clawson; the countywide map (https://emery.utah.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/cntyzone.pdf) only labels Clawson. ZoningPoint and web searches found nothing. The Emery County 2026 Zoning Ordinance does not mention Clawson and was not used.
Codes RA ('Residential Agricultural') and I ('Industrial') are the GIS layer's own labels; the name of R-1 is unconfirmed. Nothing else is known.
Do NOT substitute other Utah RA or I districts. Ask Clawson Town or Emery County Building and Zoning (zoning contacts are in the county permit packet).
Every field except district codes and layer labels is null/empty because nothing was verified.
